# Will your bank accept this ACH file?

> Free ACH file checker for payroll and vendor-payment files: finds bad record lengths, routing-number check digits, wrong entry hash and control totals, missing block padding and weekend effective dates, and rebuilds the control records. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
